duzeltme.govde:
Both sorts below put an array into ascending order. Which of the following statements are true?
I. After k passes of selection sort, the first k elements are the k smallest elements of the array, in sorted order.
II. After k passes of insertion sort, the first k + 1 elements are in sorted order, but they are not necessarily the smallest elements of the array.
III. Insertion sort makes fewer comparisons on an array of 10 distinct values that is already sorted than on the same 10 values in reverse order.
duzeltme.aciklama:
1. I: Seçmeli sıralama → ilk k konum kesin ve en küçükler → doğru.
2. II: Eklemeli sıralama → ilk k + 1 eleman yalnızca kendi aralarında sıralı → doğru.
3. III: Sıralı dizide n - 1 = 9, ters dizide n(n - 1)/2 = 45 karşılaştırma → doğru.
